cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The jam has my permission to leave. Have you found room for it in your suitcase?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I leave it here? There's no room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may reorganize. Open the case; I'll approve what comes out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It fits now. Can I go?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The arrangement is approved. Lift it onto the bed; I haven't cleared you to carry all that weight.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers leaving the jam and B4 solves packing, plausibly trying to finish the visit.

heightening.evidence: B4 clears the capacity obstacle; A5 accepts that success but extends approval to the resulting full case.

reservation: 86: the weight pretext is plausible after fuller packing but not proven necessary. This is delaying behavior, not a genuine baggage-safety finding.
